title: Rename the 'shows three Switch widgets' test in notifications_screen_l1_test.dart to match its findsNWidgets(4) assertion

evidence.quote: testWidgets('shows three Switch widgets (reminder, streak alert, reward)', (

why: The test's own inline comment (line 190) admits the count is 4 ("Three per-preference switches plus one in DeviceNotificationToggle"), a leftover from before the device-level toggle (layer 1 / DEC-27) was added. Anyone reading the test name without the assertion gets the wrong mental model of the screen, and a future edit that trims the count back to 3 would pass the misleadingly-named test while silently dropping the device toggle.
recommendation: Rename to something like "shows four Switch widgets (reminder, streak alert, reward, device toggle)".
acceptance_criteria: Test title reflects the literal 4 in findsNWidgets(4); assertion unchanged.
